theme: Dark Mystical Island Survival Shooter (Tactical Gothic UI)

typography.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-wider
typography.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wide

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive element (button, input, tab, modal, HUD widget, list item) MUST include a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

landing_and_login.description: Atmospheric full-screen entry with fog particle background, lore prologue text stream, guest username input, and instant play trigger.

main_menu.description: Central hub allowing players to enter Solo/Practice mode, view Global Leaderboards, explore Island Lore Codex, or customize graphics/audio settings.

in_game_hud.description: 2D overlay on top of R3F 3D Canvas with vital meters, crosshair, enemy threat radar, kill feed, ammo display, damage directional flashes, and pause menu.

game_over.description: Post-match screen displaying final score, survival time, creatures vanquished, leaderboard placement status, and automated score submission feedback.

lore_codex.description: Interactive creature bestiary and ancient island archives detailing shape-shifting hogs, panthers, bears, and primordial titans.

leaderboard.description: Global rankings leaderboard showing top players, scores, survival durations, favorite weapons, and search/pagination controls.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Never rely on default browser styles or plain unstyled inputs for game UI.
Ensure total dark theme contrast compliance with glowing accents for interactive HUD elements.
Apply backdrop-blur and semi-opaque backgrounds for UI overlays over 3D canvas so text remains legible against dynamic 3D scenes.
Include hover audio feedback / subtle scale transform (scale-105) on menu buttons.
All components must be written in React JavaScript (.js files).
Keep key interaction states distinct (Default, Hover, Focus, Active, Disabled).
